text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Starting today, my trainee and I will be taking on the Twinkle Series. The Umamusume joining me for this journey is none other than…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Good day to you, Trainer. I'm Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: My dream? …I do wish to be a prim and proper Japanese lady. That said, however…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If I am to blossom, I shall do so at the very peak, and nowhere else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, <chrname> and I take our first steps towards competing in the Twinkle Series!
